text:
leah: Quick poll — who wants to do a commuter challenge next week? run vs climb to work (or hybrid). Winner gets bragging rights + a small trophy (totally homemade).
tom: love it. Ill be Team Run. aiming for 3x/week.
nada: climb?? where would we stash crash pads on weekdays 😂
nada: btw im Ada (new) hi everyone, i boulder outdoors on weekends
hugo: team climb here. can do evening wall sessions after work if ppl want to trade commute miles for minutes.
fitbot: New challenge created: Commuter Sprint vs Crimp Challenge 3c3 Start: Mon 09:00 End: Fri 18:00. Log entries with #commuter-challenge.
sam: poll: react :runner: = run commute, :mountain_bicyclist: = climb/indoor, :handshake: = hybrid (run + wall).
iris: hybrid. will run 2x and climb 2x. also can host a 30min post-work boulder basics session Tue.
leah: ok hosts: iris for Tue basics, hugo for midweek tape/music. sam can do leaderboard updates?
sam: sure Ill track distance and number of climbs. quick ask: anyone have a wearable sync method or should we trust honor system + pics?
ada: honor system + photo of shoes or wall selfie is fine. no one is turning into a data tyrant here 😅
hugo: small prize idea: leftover company stickers + a banana trophy?
leah: banana trophy is actually iconic.
fitbot: Reminder: Safety guidelines pinned in #random 4dd Please warm up, wear reflective gear for run commutes, and secure pads when stashing at the office.
tom: tips: daylight in morning is 🔑. run with a headlamp if heading out early.
ada: can someone share quick wall commute routes? Id prefer under 30min detour.
iris: DM me your start point; Ill map a 2025min climb-friendly route near the office entrance.
sam: signup sheet: reply with "Run" "Climb" or "Hybrid" and your preferred days. Ill post a calendar invite for group warm-ups.
leah: Run (Mon/Wed/Fri)
tom: Run (Mon/Thu)
nada: Climb (Tue/Thu eve)
hugo: Climb (Mon/Wed)
iris: Hybrid (Tue/Wed)
sam: Calendar event created 4c5 Commuter Challenge Kickoff 3c3 Mon 08:30-08:45 Link: https://calendar.redwood.work/event/2100159999
leah: ok team — keep it fun, be safe, and post weird post-commute selfies. prize depends on creativity.
